_note: Voice lines for talk/kids.html, one list per slide (slide 1 = index 0). Edit the text, then: node tools/voices.mjs  (only missing/changed lines are re-made). Cast = FW3D's Polaroid narrators.

diego.audio_profile: A keen young backwoods deckhand with a thick Southern hillbilly drawl, leaning over your shoulder on a fishing boat, excited and a little loud, coaching you like it is the biggest moment of his life. Friendly to kids.

earl.audio_profile: A gravel-throated mountain man who runs a boat-repair shed, heavy Appalachian drawl, dropped g's, leaning back in his chair close to the mic, grinning, never raising his voice. Dry and funny, never mean.

rusty.audio_profile: Earl's homemade robot nephew who lives in the shed with the servers. Cheerful, quick and precise with a country twang, a tiny bit robotic, proud of knowing things, always kind.

slides: Well howdy, class! Deckhand Diego here. Today you're gonna learn you can build anything. I'm sure of it. Mostly sure.
He ain't been sure of nothin' since the day he was born.
Engineers break stuff... on purpose! Now that is my kinda job!
Rockets blow up so the next one don't. Same thing happens to my boats.
Three tries! The first one sank. The second one sank. The third one... she floats!
Beep. Two outta three sinkin' ain't bad for a Tuesday.
A.I. is a lot like me, cousin. It read the whole internet, and now it guesses the next word. Like guessin' where the catfish are.
And it's wrong about as often as Diego.
Talkin' to A.I. is like tellin' your fishin' buddy what you want. What, details, rules... then check his work!
Always check his work. Trust me.
Type it. Print it. Hold it! Kai made this motor holder outta nothin' but words.
The A.I. finds the parts and drops 'em right in the shoppin' cart!
And a grown-up still pushes the buy button. That's the important part.
Back in my day, instructions came in a language nobody spoke. Now the robot draws 'em, LEGO style, one step at a time.
Nine volts would fry the little brain like a hush puppy. Two resistors shrink it down to a tiny sip it can read.
Drivin' the boat is a video game now! Fire the lasers!
Rocket builders, game makers, doctors, architects. Every kind of engineer has got a robot buddy now.
Safety first! Never tell an A.I. your full name, your school, or where you live.
And ask a grown-up before you plug anything in. Ask me how I know.
Your turn, cousins! Write your own A.I. message. What, details, rules, and check!
Weirder than Diego, if you can manage it.
Beep boop. Y'all come back now.
